descriptions.en: Lists Android devices connected over ADB (USB, Wi-Fi or emulator) and iPhones/iPads connected over USB, with name, OS version, connection type and battery. One click takes a screenshot or starts and stops a screen recording; files are saved to your Mac (your macOS screenshot folder by default) and screenshots are also copied to the clipboard. Android: the clipboard button sends text to the phone's clipboard or pulls the phone's clipboard onto your Mac, with nothing installed on the phone; recording runs on the phone, survives unplugging, and stops and saves automatically at a configurable limit. iPhone/iPad: screenshots and recordings (with device audio) are captured like QuickTime does — the first use compiles a small helper with the Xcode command line tools and asks for camera access, because macOS treats the iOS screen as a camera. Click a device for a detail page: Android shows live CPU, GPU, memory and battery stats plus full specs (SoC and core clusters, GPU and graphics APIs, RAM and storage, display, battery health, build, kernel); iOS shows live battery, power, battery health and storage plus chip, RAM, storage, resolution, battery capacity and cycles, OS build, serial and UDID. Android needs adb (Android platform-tools); iOS devices just need to trust this Mac.
descriptions.zh-Hans: 列出通过 ADB 连接的 Android 设备（USB、Wi-Fi 或模拟器）和通过 USB 连接的 iPhone / iPad，显示名称、系统版本、连接方式和电量。一键截图或开始/停止录屏，文件保存到 Mac（默认跟随 macOS 截图位置），截图同时复制到剪贴板。Android：剪贴板按钮可把文本写入手机剪贴板，或把手机剪贴板读到 Mac，无需在手机上安装 App；录屏在手机端运行，拔线不中断，到达可设置的最长时长后自动停止并保存。iPhone / iPad：截图与录屏（含手机声音）与 QuickTime 同一通道，首次使用会用 Xcode 命令行工具编译一个小助手并请求摄像头权限（macOS 把 iOS 屏幕当作摄像头管理）。点击设备进入详情页：Android 实时查看 CPU、GPU、内存与电池，以及 SoC 与核心簇、GPU 与图形 API、内存与存储、屏幕、电池健康、系统版本与内核等完整规格；iOS 实时查看电量、功率、电池健康与存储，以及芯片、内存、存储、分辨率、电池容量与循环次数、系统版本、序列号和 UDID。Android 需要 adb（Android platform-tools）；iOS 设备只需信任这台 Mac。

summaries.en: Android & iOS device panel: screenshots, recording, clipboard sync and specs
summaries.zh-Hans: 列出已连接的 Android 与 iOS 设备：一键截图、录屏、剪贴板互传，查看硬件详情与电池健康
